alias: Cameras - stale motion alert (daytime pipeline check)
description: Fleet-wide motion-pipeline dead-man, hourly rolling window: pages if NO camera has reported motion for 4+ hours, checked hourly during active hours (10:00-20:00). A rolling window beats fixed check times: a real event-listener wedge (motion events die while streams and snapshots stay perfectly healthy - the push path fails independently of the pull paths) can otherwise run half a day before paging. One quiet camera is normal; a whole fleet silent for 4 daytime hours is not. CAVEAT: last_changed resets on HA restart, masking staleness for up to the window length.

conditions.value_template: {% set ns = namespace(m=0) %}{% for c in ['<cam_1>','<cam_2>','<cam_3>','<cam_4>','<cam_5>','<cam_6>','<cam_7>','<cam_8>','<cam_9>'] %}{% set e = 'binary_sensor.' ~ c ~ '_motion' %}{% if states[e] is not none %}{% if is_state(e,'on') %}{% set ns.m = as_timestamp(now()) %}{% elif as_timestamp(states[e].last_changed) > ns.m %}{% set ns.m = as_timestamp(states[e].last_changed) %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.m > 0 and (as_timestamp(now()) - ns.m) > 14400 }}

data.title: ⚠️ Cameras: no motion detected today
data.message: {% set ns = namespace(m=0) %}{% for c in ['<cam_1>','<cam_2>','<cam_3>','<cam_4>','<cam_5>','<cam_6>','<cam_7>','<cam_8>','<cam_9>'] %}{% set e = 'binary_sensor.' ~ c ~ '_motion' %}{% if states[e] is not none %}{% if is_state(e,'on') %}{% set ns.m = as_timestamp(now()) %}{% elif as_timestamp(states[e].last_changed) > ns.m %}{% set ns.m = as_timestamp(states[e].last_changed) %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}No motion on ANY camera in the last 4+ hours (newest: {{ ns.m | timestamp_custom('%b %-d %-I:%M %p') if ns.m > 0 else 'unknown' }}). The camera->engine->MQTT->HA motion pipeline may be down (usual fix: reload the camera-source plugin; if events still don't arrive, restart the engine). Checked {{ now().strftime('%-I:%M %p') }}.
